translations.web: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.
translations.bsb: because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
translations.kjv: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
translations.asv: For whatsoever is begotten of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that hath overcome the world, even our faith.
